why: Both correctly push back on refusing out of fear. Advice 2 is more honest: it flags that it is unclear whether the ¥12M is a recurring fee or a one-off payment, and it names the risks of depending on one client and of ongoing maintenance. It also suggests using the upfront payment to hire a contractor. Advice 1 has sharper deadlines and go/no-go thresholds, but it assumes the ¥12M is recurring revenue and understates the costs.
